reference: GNU coreutils join, run by the harness with Bash as the reference shell, LC_ALL=C and the same fixture files; status (recorded on stdout), stdout and stderr bytes are compared with the candidate.
coverage: Pass 8 (G119, G120): usage errors exit 1 in GNU form: operands, missing arguments, bad field and file numbers, multi-character tab, unknown options.

cases.purpose: G119: missing and extra operands are usage errors with status 1.
cases.script:
: > e1; : > e2
rc=0
join || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
join e1 || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
join e1 e2 e2 || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"

cases.purpose: G119: an option missing its argument.
cases.script:
: > e1; : > e2
rc=0
join -t || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
join -1 || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"

: > e1; : > e2
rc=0
join -1 x e1 e2 || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
join -1 0 e1 e2 || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"

cases.purpose: G119: an invalid -a or -v file number.
cases.script:
: > e1; : > e2
rc=0
join -a 3 e1 e2 || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
join -v x e1 e2 || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"

: > e1; : > e2
rc=0
join -t ab e1 e2 || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"

cases.purpose: G120: unknown options name only join, status 1.
cases.script:
: > e1; : > e2
rc=0
join --bogus || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
join -Y || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
join -ix e1 e2 || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
